media:content.media:description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. item.description: The wall of ice, water and rock that tore through Nepal last week has claimed more than 1,200 lives and left more than 4,000 missing, depriving many grieving families of a basic rite: funerals.

media:content.media:text: Nepal Flash Flood Leaves Hundreds Dead And Thousands Missing in Himalayan Border District
media:content.media:description: A relative mourns during the symbolic cremation of four members of the Magar family who remain missing after the flash floods, using effigies made of Kush grass, at Pashupatinath Temple on September 02, 2026 in Kathmandu, Nepal. The floods, triggered by a glacier collapse on Langtang Lirung on August 26, have killed at least 900 people and left nearly 4,000 missing in Nepal as of September 1, with additional deaths and hundreds missing in neighboring Tibet, authorities have said.
